description:
Flexcompute is a cutting-edge technology startup that specializes in ultra-fast simulation technology. Our products are utilized by companies in designing and optimizing technology products, with applications ranging from designing airplanes and cars to wind turbines and quantum computing chips. Our customer base includes both household names and startups in emerging industries. Our company was founded by world-renowned leaders in simulation technology from Stanford University and MIT. Backed by top VC firms, we are poised to disrupt the billion-dollar engineering simulation industry with our fast-growing trajectory
 Responsibility 
 You will play a crucial role in the design, development, and optimization of our backend 3D geometry, visualization, and meshing technology, conduct architectural design, and optimize product performance and experience. As a key force in our team, you will play a central role in advancing the application of cutting-edge 3D technology. You will work closely with our R&D team and front-end engineers to implement new features, improve user experience, and ensure the highest quality standards are met. Your work will contribute to the continued growth and success of Flexcompute Inc. as a leader in simulation technology.
 Design and develop parallel, scalable, and real-time algorithms to support geometry manipulation, meshing, mesh adaptation, and interactive 3D visualization tools.
 Profile and optimize feature implementation to improve speed and scalability on CPUs/GPUs
 Collaborate with teams developing the user-interface and scientific visualization tools/technologies making user experience a priority
 Engage with Product Management, Quality Assurance, and Documentation teams to accomplish product milestones in a timely manner
 Follow sound software engineering practices like continuous integration and code review. The code we write today will underpin our platform simulation products for years to come – it needs to be maintainable, extensible and robust
 Why Join Us? 
 Embarking on a career with Flexcompute means stepping onto a path of transformative growth and innovation. As part of our team, you’ll have exciting opportunities to shape the future of CFD simulation. Here, your work directly contributes to developing products that are not only groundbreaking but also sustainably advancing the engineering landscape. We offer a highly collaborative environment, competitive compensation, and a benefits package designed to support our team's well-being and professional development.
 If you’re driven by the prospect of making a lasting impact and eager to be at the forefront of technological innovation, we invite you to apply.
 Requirements 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field; solid foundation in computer science and networking.
 Strong background in Computational Geometry, Graphics, and Meshing. Knowledge of numerical approximations.
 C/C++/Cuda/MPI/OpenMP for scientific computing and Python (or similar) for scripting
 5+ years of work experience, 3+ years in meshing / graphics intensive development with proven contribution; exceptional candidates can be considered with relaxed criteria.
 Good team collaboration and communication skills, adept at analyzing and solving problems with design solutions.
 Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
 
 Preferred
 Industry experience in implementing and testing new features in commercial meshing software for CFD solvers
 PhD in Computational Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering
 Expertise in one or more of the following topics:
 Adaptive mesh refinement
 Delaunay triangulation or advancing front method
 Multi-threaded data structures for surface and volume meshing
 Development of scalable, parallel scientific software using MPI, OpenMP, or CUDA
 Scientific visualization techniques
 
 Benefits 
 
 Competitive compensation with equity of a fast-growing startup.
 Medical, dental, and vision health insurance.
 401(k) Contribution.
 Gym allowance.
 Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.
